### Source

Choose the framework entry that matches your application.

::: code-group

```html [Web Component]
<script type="module">
  import '@zeus-web/progress/wc/auto'
</script>

<zw-progress value="64" max="100" label="Upload progress"></zw-progress>
```

```tsx [React]
import { Progress } from '@zeus-web/progress/react'

}
```


## Add

```bash
zweb add progress
```

## Imports

Styled registry component:

```tsx
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress'
```

Primitive React wrapper:

```tsx
import { Progress } from '@zeus-web/progress/react'
```

Web Component entry:

```ts
import '@zeus-web/progress/wc/auto'
```

## Props

| Prop            | Type      | Default | Description                        |
| --------------- | --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `value`         | `number`  | -       | Current progress value.            |
| `max`           | `number`  | `100`   | Maximum progress value.            |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | -       | Whether progress is indeterminate. |
| `label`         | `string`  | -       | Accessible progress label.         |

No public events documented.

## AI usage rules

Do:

- Use Progress to represent task completion.

Do not:

- Do not use Progress as a generic loading spinner.
